note: Missouri Department of Conservation area of woodland and restored prairie west of Wellsville, with two stocked lakes (electric motors only). MDC's primitive camping area is a gravel pull-off beside the picnic shelter above the Lake Walter boat ramp, with parking and a privy at the ramp; no other amenities. Reached from Route RA by the area's gravel road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: map-designated primitive camping beside the shelter at the Lake Walter boat ramp (GIS 148) on a gravel pull-off loop. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin fine; phone matches; not waterfront kept.
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas shown on map ... No amenities provided.'; the 2025 area map has one 'Primitive Camping' symbol beside the Shelter, Parking Lot, Privy and Concrete Boat Ramp at Lake Walter; GIS 27 point 148 'Primitive Camping Area'. Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.
PIN fine: stored 39.06844,-91.63063 = GIS 148, on a gravel pull-off loop off the area road beside the shelter building; ramp lot 166 is 71 m SE and lot 1445 61 m E. Drivable for a 23-ft rig.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The pull-off is ~55 m from Lake Walter (roughly 7-8 acres) down a slope with scattered trees; a lakeview is possible leaf-off but not shown by any page, so no upgrade.
HORSES: brochure 'Bicycles and horses allowed on public roadways year-round' - no horse camp. CLUSTERS: a single camping symbol among nine lots.
Season (year-round, manual) left; brochure 'Seasonal restrictions may apply' names none.
